 Analysis: When the STP_BookTransaction Utility tried to post the transaction got the Null response from the Finacle/OMNI, so the WorkItem get routed to the Checker WorkStep. But the the posting call done by STP_BookTransaction Utility processed the tranaction from the Finacle Backend. This causes the posting twice.Resolution : This issue is with finacle/OMNI side.

Transaction Posting Failures (Unlien Error) Some transactions failed to post due to the below error: Sorry, we could not unlien your account despite liens already having been lifted in Finacle.Analysis: During the ERP integration deployment (UG, RW, TZ), an unapproved line of code was introduced, which was not part of the release build. This caused the unLien to fail.Resolution: After removing that line of code redeploying
